name: GREEN DEMON (alt)
author: -(nano4618)
description: Go under the ball portal as the ship at 43%. Fall to the floor between the spikes at 45%. Fly back into the level before the yellow pad at 58%. Go above the ship portal at 64%. Hold to the ceiling at 73% between the platforms. Drop down from the ceiling at 83% and then go back to the ceiling at 88%. Fall back to the floor between the saws at 97%. Free to the end from there.
